purpose: Provide a tenant-scoped durable handoff ledger and append-only ordered PDX-013 notification receipt inbox without changing the V54 generic command-receipt ledger.
requiredSchemaProperties: service-local keys and foreign keys only
tenant_id on every row and forced row-level security
exact sourceEventId, intentId, recipientUserId, receiptSequence and canonical digest binding
same sequence plus same digest is idempotent; same sequence plus different digest is rejected
lower or skipped receipt sequence is rejected unless the exact sealed recovery rule permits it
terminal receipt evidence is immutable and delete is rejected
handoff claim uses bounded lease, attempt count, retry eligibility and dead-letter terminal state
no rendered body, PII, provider credential, raw destination, arbitrary URL, object bytes or cross-service foreign key
activationRule: Recheck backend origin/dwp-dev, V55 hash and V56 absence after the preparation carrier is pushed and immediately before worktree authoring. Record a separate activation artifact.
invalidationConditions: People HR high-water is no longer V55
the allocated V56 path exists from another owner
the implementation requires a second migration or a cross-service schema dependency
the module worktree base differs from the issued token
